metadata.description: Plugins by Eduardo Cruz — tooling for founders whose AI agents do the building.

plugins.name: throughline
plugins.description: Give your AI agent the context it is missing about your business: the week goal it should judge work against, and what is open and on whom. Plus a 10-check diagnosis of your repo. Runs on your machine — no account.

plugins.name: 6529-validator-mod
plugins.description: Set up and watch a 6529 validator on your own DigitalOcean server, step by step in a pane beside the chat. Uses DigitalOcean's own doctl; the mod never holds your token or keys.
